name: io.github.jonradoff/agentstore
description: Read-only admin MCP server for AgentStore — dashboards, users, tenants, billing, logs, health.

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSTORE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the AgentStore instance (e.g., https://your-app.fly.dev or http://localhost:4290)

environmentVariables.name: AGENTSTORE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Root-tenant API key with admin authority (starts with lsk_). Create in Admin → API Keys.
